source_refs.note: 4- Alcohol: a main subheading of 15.7.2 Use and Abuse of Drugs, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 49-49.

blocks.text: Alcohol ek psychoactive drug hai jo kai shaklon, jaise beer, wine aur spirits, mein pi jati hai. Yeh sukoon aur sarsoor (shadeed khushi ya josh) ka ehsas deti hai. Is ke bure asraat mein soch aur harkat (cognitive aur motor functions) ki kharabi, jigar ki bimariyan, dil ki bimariyan aur zehni bimariyan shamil hain.
